title: MCP show carries about 4 KB of inert fields on the agent path
outcome: The agent-facing show is terse: no UUIDs, hashes, fences, revision counters, or control-plane fields (obligation_page, run, completion_seal); history summaries carry meaning beyond change_kind; the host-private channel keeps the rich projection
acceptance: MCP show for a typical item is under 1 KB and contains no hash or UUID; parity covers CLI text and MCP

completion.summary: Replaced agent-facing show with a terse allowlisted projection while preserving the rich host core view. Show now carries short refs, relative identities, typed notes, bounded meaningful history, and exact guidance across CLI and MCP.
